name: printed_total takes the FIRST summary instead of the last
expect: an earlier quoted summary does not win over the real one
a trailing SECOND summary is what gets read (known limit)

name: the `passed` requirement is dropped, so any ratio counts
expect: a ratio on a line without the word is ignored

name: the `N of M` arm is dropped from RATIO
expect: `32 of 32 … passed` reads 32

name: coverage may shrink — a pinned script that stopped declaring passes
expect: a pinned script that stopped declaring fails
…and it names the script

name: a new declaration may arrive unmeasured
expect: a new declaration outside POPULATION fails

name: borrow_errors swallows a missing upstream name
edits: return [n for n in BORROWED if not hasattr(mod, n)]
expect: a missing borrowed name is named, not swallowed

name: a bare mention of `cases` counts as a declaration
expect: a bare `7 cases` mention is NOT a declaration

name: unparseable source is treated as a declaration
expect: unparseable source is not a declaration

name: #402: docstrings count as references
expect: a docstring or a comment naming a file is NOT a reference

name: #402: an import reaches any suffix, not only a .py
edits: if p.suffix == ".py" and p.stem in imports:
expect: an import matches a .py only — `import backlog` does not reach docs/backlog.md

name: #402: a string constant is never a reference
edits: return any(p.name in s for s in strings)
expect: a string constant holding the basename IS a reference
a string reference is ONE hop; an import is closed to a fixpoint

name: #402: string references are closed transitively too
edits: if key not in reach and imports & stems:
if key not in reach and (imports & stems or any(depends_on(refs[name], p) for p in reach)):
expect: a string reference is ONE hop; an import is closed to a fixpoint

name: #402: the import fixpoint never runs
expect: a string reference is ONE hop; an import is closed to a fixpoint

name: #402: two-dot diff, so the base's own later commits are in scope
expect: --changed reaches a script committed since the base

name: #402: uncommitted edits are out of scope
expect: an UNCOMMITTED edit is in scope, with its importer

name: #402: untracked files are out of scope
expect: an UNTRACKED script is in scope

name: #402: a git failure is an empty scope
expect: an unknown base is CANNOT RUN, never an empty scope

name: #402: an unknown --only name is skipped
expect: --only with a name outside POPULATION is an ERROR, never a skip

name: #402: a scripts/ prefix is not stripped
edits: picked = {n[len("scripts/"):] if n.startswith("scripts/") else n for n in names}
expect: --only accepts a bare name or a scripts/ path

name: #402: audit ignores `only`
edits: for name in sorted(pinned & found if only is None else pinned & found & only):
expect: scoped to the green one, the red suite does not run

name: #402: the population ratchet is scoped too
edits: problems.extend(population_errors(found if only is None else found & only, pinned if only is None else pinned & only))
expect: …but the population ratchet is never scoped
